note: Adapted from Light & Wilson 1936, original in English (The nasute termites of the Philippines, The Philippine Journal of Science 60: 461–520). Type collection No. 318, Zamboanga Province, Mindanao; the soldier measurements are from a further large soldier of collection 318 from Jolo Island. The alate is described only by comparison with N. luzonicus and is not restated point by point; the worker is not described in the original. Fig. 14 (alate head in dorsal view, several soldier heads in dorsal view showing size and proportion variation, soldier head in lateral view, soldier left mandible variation) not translated.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Placed in the matangensis group. Alate very close to N. luzonicus, differing only in the pronotum possibly slightly darker and the fontanelle small and inconspicuous (frequently variable in the latter). Soldier head orange-brown, antennae 13-segmented, outline in dorsal view as in N. luzonicus; free part of the mandible usually rather long, outer margin slightly oblique, anterior notch short and deep, molar region short, followed by a short flat area and then by a slightly concave inner margin.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Very close to the alate of N. luzonicus; pronotum perhaps slightly darker; fontanelle small, inconspicuous (often variable in N. luzonicus). Otherwise as in N. luzonicus. Measurements (mm, from type collection No. 318, a typical alate from Zamboanga Province, Mindanao): total length 15.2; fore wing length 13.4; fore wing width 3.4; head length 1.65; head capsule length 1.20; head capsule width 1.30; head width (including compound eyes) 1.57; pronotum length 0.74; pronotum width 1.32; compound eye long diameter 0.56, short diameter 0.48; ocellus long diameter 0.20, short diameter 0.14; distance from ocellus to compound eye 0.06.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head orange-brown; base of the nasus darker, apex pale red; antennae, thorax and abdominal tergites yellow with a brownish tinge; legs yellow. Head and nasus shape as in Fig. 14 b and e; outline in dorsal view as in N. luzonicus; mandible variable (Fig. 14 f—i), but the free part usually rather long; outer margin slightly oblique; anterior notch short and deep; molar region short, followed by a short flat area and then by a slightly concave inner margin. Antennae 13-segmented, almost as long as head plus nasus. Measurements (mm and indices, from collection 318, a large soldier from Jolo Island): head plus nasus 1.80; head length (excluding nasus) 1.14; nasus length 0.66; head projection 0.30; head height 0.78; head width 1.26; fore tibia length 1.14; head index 1.10; head-nasus index 0.56; head projection index 0.26; leg extension index 1.00.
